mentions.name: GeoPeek
mentions.description: A macOS Quick Look extension for GeoJSON files: pressing Space on a .geojson in Finder shows a map preview instead of raw JSON, along with an attribute table and basic stats.
mentions.problem: Previewing GeoJSON files in Finder only showed raw JSON; there was no quick way to see the underlying map.
mentions.source_excerpt: GeoPeek, a small macOS Quick Look extension for GeoJSON. I work with geospatial data and wanted to press Space on a .geojson in Finder and see a map instead of raw JSON. It also shows an attribute table and basic stats.
